services.desc: Ready to take the stage and share your unique sense of humor? Laughs Comedy Club is excited to offer beginner stand-up comedy classes designed to help you write, polish, and perform your very first set! Join our creative, fun, and motivating 5-week beginner’s class, focused on the essentials of writing and performing stand-up comedy. This course is perfect for new or aspiring comedians looking for expert guidance and a supportive environment. Your classes will be led by Andrew Frank, a Seattle-based comedian with an impressive touring history spanning 285 cities and 11 countries.
